description: Source code for the 'stat_mgmt' group in Zephyr's mcumgr management framework, handling statistics management commands such as show and list.

methods.name: stats_mgmt_count_plus_one
methods.description: Increments a counter for each statistic entry found in a group.

methods.name: stat_mgmt_count
methods.description: Counts the number of statistics entries in a specified group.

methods.name: stat_mgmt_walk_cb
methods.description: Callback to process each statistic entry during walk.

methods.name: stat_mgmt_foreach_entry
methods.description: Iterates over each statistic entry in a group, calling a provided callback.

methods.name: stat_mgmt_cb_encode
methods.description: Encodes a statistic entry into CBOR format.

methods.name: stat_mgmt_show
methods.description: Handles the 'stat show' command to retrieve specific statistic details.

methods.name: stat_mgmt_list
methods.description: Handles the 'stat list' command to list all statistic groups.

methods.name: stat_mgmt_translate_error_code
methods.description: Translates internal error codes to MCUmgr error codes (conditional on protocol support).

methods.name: stat_mgmt_register_group
methods.description: Registers the stat management group with the management framework.
